mentions.h: R.W.A. NATIONAL TWENTY MILES CHAMPIONSHIP, SUDBURY.
FROM THE BELGRAVIAN 25 years ago... and 40 years ago...

mentions.note: won the 100 miles Bath to London Race; 4th in the Olympic 50k Walk

photos.c: Above: G.B.R. Whitlock (Met.W.C), on this occasion winner of the 100 miles Bath to London Race, placed 4th in the 50k Walk in the Olympics.
